answer: Epoch haven entry needs a willow bond of 5*delta*k^2 per identity: k is how many identities the same funding address already bonded, delta is one stake unit. Fake #1 pays 5, fake #10 pays 500; N fakes total 5*N(N+1)(2N+1)/6 (1,925 for 10, 1.7M for 100). Funder-sharding (fresh addresses to reset k=1) fails because each new funding address costs one delta to register. The willow curve bends but never breaks: each bond hashes to its owner's answer, so clones cannot pool deposits.
